provenance.paper_title: WorldLines: Benchmarking and Modeling Long-Horizon Stateful Embodied Agents

representation_paths.memory_component: visibility-aware memories and action-native state trails

evidence.paraphrase: ObsMem tracks visibility, action history, and changing household state for embodied planning.

State trails update overwritten world states under partial observability. For ObsMem, this specifically supports fixed-rule correction of stored state of visibility-aware memories and action-native state trails.

evidence.section: Full paper: Benchmarks for Long-Horizon Agent Memory
evidence.paraphrase: Evidence-linked state records are connected across dialogue and action traces. For ObsMem, this specifically supports relinking or reindexing of stored items of visibility-aware memories and action-native state trails.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 7): During inference, the operative memory component (visibility-aware memories and action-native state trails) changes through fixed-rule correction of stored state, relinking or reindexing of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
